title: Todd Monken responds to Mike Tomlin: It's not Browns being Browns, it's Browns playing poorly for one week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken responds to Mike Tomlin: It's not Browns being Browns, it's Browns playing poorly for one week
sources.description: During the pregame show for Sunday night's matchup between the Cowboys and Giants, new NBC analyst Mike Tomlin quoted one of his former players when talking about Cleveland's ugly 34-10 loss to Jacksonville.
